name: Alter Ego
source:
Alter Ego is an artificial intelligence. He is created by and based on the appearance of Fujisaki Chihiro, his creator, however, Alter Ego is able to turn his screen into anyone else that it wants to be.

[From [url=http://danganronpa.wikia.com/wiki/Alter_Ego]Danganronpa Wikia[/url]]
